name: MonadOmics 生信工具箱
description: 在本机完成表达矩阵质控、差异表达、功能富集、组学作图和预后建模，输出可复核的数据表与图形。
description_zh: 在本机完成表达矩阵质控、差异表达、功能富集、组学作图和预后建模，输出可复核的数据表与图形。
description_en: Local expression analysis, enrichment, figures and prognostic models with R-derived tables and plots.
examples_zh: 检查我的生信分析环境，告诉我差异表达分析还缺哪些 R 包。
用这份原始 count 矩阵和样本表比较疾病组与对照组，并生成 PCA、火山图和热图。
对这批人类上调基因做 GO 富集，用实际检测到的基因作背景，并报告未映射的 ID。
用这份生存数据和候选基因建立 LASSO-Cox 模型，报告事件数、系数和验证限制。
examples_en: Check my bioinformatics environment and list the R packages missing for differential expression.
Compare disease and control groups using these raw counts and sample annotations, then make PCA, volcano and heatmap figures.
Run GO enrichment for these human genes using measured genes as the background, and report unmapped IDs.
Build a LASSO-Cox model from this survival table and candidate genes, reporting events, coefficients and validation limits.
